description: A WorkSpec tag-plan artifact: the tagging actions needed to converge on an attribution result.

slug.description: Stable filename slug. Optional: the loader derives it from the artifact's filename under `.workspec/<kind-dir>/<slug>.yaml` when absent; when present it must already be a valid slug.

spec.description: The tag plan body: optional name, baseline anchor, dimension→tag mapping, and entries.

baselineAsOf.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp: the Inventory `asOf` this plan was computed against (the drift-check anchor).

entries.description: One entry per resource × tag. MUST be sorted ascending by (resourceId, tag) — the sort-order contract (see README).

items.description: One resource × tag entry in the tag plan.

action.description: The tagging action this entry represents: add (current null, desired set), change (both set and different), remove (current set, desired null), or noop (equal).

anyOf.description: A resource tag value: at most 256 characters. No character restriction.

current.description: Current tag value, or null if the tag is not currently set.

anyOf.description: A resource tag value: at most 256 characters. No character restriction.

desired.description: Desired tag value, or null if the tag should not be set.

resourceId.description: Resource id this entry concerns (matches an Inventory resource id).

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this tag plan.

additionalProperties.description: A resource tag name: 1-512 characters, must not contain < > % & \ ? / (Azure rule).

tagMapping.description: Dimension id → tag name mapping, e.g. { product: "fs-product" }. Must not be empty.

title: WorkSpec TagPlan (v1alpha1)
